places.name: Tiger Hill Sunrise Viewpoint
places.description: Offers the most dramatic Himalayan sunrise panorama accessible by road anywhere in India.
places.bestTime: October to April, pre-dawn (4–5 AM departure from town)

places.name: Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (Toy Train)
places.description: One of the world's great mountain railway journeys — a living piece of Victorian engineering heritage.
places.bestTime: October to November and March to May for clear skies

places.name: Kangchenjunga View from Observatory Hill
places.description: The most accessible in-town viewpoint for Kangchenjunga, combined with a genuine living temple.

places.name: Happy Valley Tea Estate
places.description: The only chance to walk through a genuine Darjeeling tea garden and watch tea processing under one roof.
places.bestTime: March to May for first flush plucking season

places.name: Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park
places.description: The best place in India to see snow leopards and red pandas in a high-altitude naturalistic setting.
places.mapsSearch: Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park Darjeeling
places.bestTime: October to March for active animals in cool weather

places.name: Himalayan Mountaineering Institute
places.description: A pilgrimage site for mountaineering history, housing Tenzing's original Everest summit gear.

places.name: Ghum Monastery (Yiga Choeling)
places.description: Darjeeling's oldest and most spiritually active monastery, perfectly combined with the toy train halt at Ghum.
places.bestTime: Early morning or evening during prayer sessions

places.name: Batasia Loop
places.description: A unique railway engineering landmark offering the best combined view of town, tea gardens, and Himalayas.

places.name: Rock Garden and Ganga Maya Park
places.description: A family-friendly garden escape with genuine waterfall scenery set on a forested mountainside.
places.bestTime: April to June for rhododendron bloom

places.name: Chowrasta (Mall Road)
places.description: The living cultural heart of Darjeeling, where the town's Nepali, Tibetan, and Bengali identities visibly converge.

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
